node.statement: Because both data have the same delta, their source sets and formulas for Pi_delta are identical. Each target is the image of that same Pi_delta, hence S_grp=S_pol=S_delta. Applying lem-stage1-polar-coherence-naturality therefore yields (u_grp,h_grp)=(u_pol,h_pol) on S_grp intersect S_pol=S_delta, in particular u_grp=u_pol on S_delta.
